source_title: Celebrities Kangana Ranaut Congratulates Omar Abdullah, Nidhi Razdan On Their Wedding
source_excerpt:
Kangana Ranaut has congratulated Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and journalist Nidhi Razdan on their wedding. The couple tied the knot in a private ceremony on Friday, with CM Omar later sharing a series of pictures from the celebrations on social media. The BJP MP and actor simply wrote, “Congratulations,” with two heart emojis.
In the pictures, the couple can be seen posing for the camera with beaming smiles. One of the photographs captured Omar Abdullah standing with his wife Nidhi on an ornate wooden staircase adorned with floral arrangements and framed artwork. The couple is dressed in traditional attire, marking a special occasion in their life together.

Another photograph captured Nidhi and CM Omar posing together in front of a floral arch adorned with pink and white blossoms.
Nidhi, too, posted photos on her social media, with the words popularised by Salman Khan. She captioned, “It’s done, bro.”
Nidhi Razdan is a journalist, television presenter and author who gained recognition as the host of NDTV 24x7’s news programme Left, Right & Centre. She spent over 22 years with the news network before stepping down in 2023.

Jammu and Kashmir hosted its first International Film Festival this year under Chief Minister Omar Abdullah’s leadership. The event featured more than 1,100 films from over 50 countries, bringing together filmmakers and celebrating cinema from across the world as well as the region. Several film industry personalities, including Ramesh Sippy, attended the festival. (With inputs from ANI)
